title: Cheap-model Builder reliability and routing hardening
description: Forty bounded packets that make KittyBuilder's cheap paid route executable, truthful, recoverable and auditable before broader HOME STRETCH product work. The first packets repair exact-model cost projection, refresh the value pair, and make persisted packet routing control manual CLI and autonomous supervisor execution. Do not claim or duplicate the separate Claude-owned builder-cycle-proof / launcher-cwd-fix lane.

packets.title: Price the exact configured models
packets.objective: Make paid-route cost projection price the configured worker and reviewer slugs instead of a hard-coded governor model.
acceptance_criteria: Changing worker_model changes projected cost.
Unknown model pricing fails loud instead of estimating zero.

packets.title: Refresh the cheap paid worker and reviewer
packets.objective: Set the cheap paid worker to openrouter/xiaomi/mimo-v2.5 and independent reviewer to openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3; keep frontier unchanged and update exact pricing/tests.
acceptance_criteria: Cheap worker and reviewer use the new independent pair.
Frontier route is unchanged and projected cheap cost stays under its ceiling.

packets.title: Resolve persisted packet routing at runtime
packets.objective: Create one deterministic resolver from persisted policy.routing to an approved configured Builder route; unsupported provider/model must fail closed.
acceptance_criteria: Persisted route resolves to one approved configured execution route.
Unknown or unconfigured routes fail before worker launch.

packets.title: Make CLI and packet routing agree
packets.objective: Use packet routing by default and reject contradictory explicit --free/--paid/model flags instead of silently overriding packet intent.
acceptance_criteria: No explicit flag uses persisted packet route.
Conflicting explicit route fails with an actionable error.

packets.title: Make autonomous supervisor honor packet routing
packets.objective: Replace the supervisor's hard-coded --free launch with the same persisted route resolver used by run-packet.
acceptance_criteria: Free packets still launch free.
Approved cheap paid packets launch the governed paid route and route conflicts fail before detach.

packets.title: Keep paid autonomous dispatch governed
packets.objective: Prove supervisor paid launches pass through existing budget/reserve policy and cannot silently escalate tier or spend when disabled.
acceptance_criteria: Disabled or over-budget paid route does not launch.
No automatic frontier escalation occurs.

packets.title: Persist the autonomous route receipt
packets.objective: Record requested and actual provider/model/tier for every detached supervisor launch without secrets or raw prompts.
acceptance_criteria: Run evidence identifies route/provider/model.
Missing actual identity is unknown, never guessed.

packets.title: Persist autonomous dispatch failures
packets.objective: When detached launch cannot start, persist the failure class and next-action evidence instead of only logging it.
acceptance_criteria: Launch failure leaves durable evidence and no fake running record.
Provider/budget/command failures remain distinguishable.

packets.title: Guard paid route config against drift
packets.objective: Add deterministic tests that paid route config, OpenCode agents, pricing registry and governor route identity cannot silently disagree.
acceptance_criteria: Model identity drift fails a focused test.
Reviewer remains independent and read-only.

packets.title: Expose exact paid route cost evidence
packets.objective: Make paid route resolution/reporting expose exact worker/reviewer pricing inputs and projected CAD cost used for authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Cost evidence names exact models and token shapes.
A missing price cannot authorize work.

packets.title: Fail closed on stale model pricing
packets.objective: Add tests preventing a configured paid Builder model from being absent from the pricing registry or priced as zero by default.
acceptance_criteria: Every configured paid model has positive explicit pricing.
Unknown paid model cannot project zero cost.

packets.title: Align governor route identity with paid config
packets.objective: Remove or guard duplicate hard-coded paid model identity so the governor cannot authorize one model while Builder invokes another.
acceptance_criteria: Cheap/frontier route identity is consistent with governed paid config.
Drift causes a deterministic failure.

packets.title: Prove packet routing persists intact
packets.objective: Strengthen manifest/apply/readback tests so policy.routing survives canonicalization, DB persistence and status/report reads exactly.
acceptance_criteria: Provider/model round-trip exactly.
Reapply cannot mutate an applied packet's route.

packets.title: Tighten packet routing validation
packets.objective: Reject malformed, contradictory, unsupported or partially specified packet routing before durable apply.
acceptance_criteria: Bad provider/model forms fail validation with all errors.
Valid configured route remains accepted.

packets.title: Teach doctor to verify paid route readiness
packets.objective: Add read-only doctor checks for paid route config consistency, exact pricing availability and executable model identity without requiring a provider completion.
acceptance_criteria: Doctor reports route/pricing drift as failure.
Doctor never claims credentials or quota are available without evidence.

packets.title: Teach doctor to verify autonomous route wiring
packets.objective: Detect if supervisor launch behavior has regressed to a fixed/free route or cannot resolve persisted packet routing.
acceptance_criteria: Doctor verifies route resolver wiring without launching work.
Failure message names the broken boundary.

packets.title: Keep provider outage outside repair budget
packets.objective: Strengthen regression coverage so provider exhaustion pauses/resumes honestly without consuming a code-repair attempt.
acceptance_criteria: Provider exhaustion is classified separately and counts_toward_budget is false.
Repeated outage cannot produce false success.

packets.title: Keep infrastructure crashes outside repair budget
packets.objective: Prove identical infrastructure crashes recover only to the configured ceiling and never consume implementation attempts.
acceptance_criteria: Crash evidence is non-budgeted.
Identical crashes stop boundedly and remain distinct from code failure.

packets.title: Reconcile stale leases and runs
packets.objective: Prove an expired worker lease cannot leave a packet simultaneously owned, running and eligible after recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Recovery produces one authoritative task/run/lease state.
Stale ownership cannot close a successor worker's lease.

packets.title: Isolate crashed attempt artifacts
packets.objective: Ensure stale-attempt reconciliation archives evidence under task+attempt and resets the retry to the immutable base.
acceptance_criteria: Different tasks cannot overwrite same-numbered attempt evidence.
Retry starts clean and archive/reset failure fails loud.

packets.title: Bound retry feedback
packets.objective: Bound validation/review feedback passed to the next worker, scope it to the packet and exclude raw secrets while retaining actionable findings.
acceptance_criteria: Feedback has an enforced size bound and packet scope.
Failure classes remain distinguishable without raw environment values.

packets.title: Fail loud on bad implementation contracts
packets.objective: Test missing, malformed, stale or mismatched implementation-result contracts so worker exit zero alone can never imply success.
acceptance_criteria: Missing/malformed/mismatched result fails the attempt.
Success requires a valid completed contract bound to this attempt.

packets.title: Fail loud on bad review contracts
packets.objective: Require a valid review result bound to the exact current review context; reviewer exit zero or a stale prior approval cannot pass.
acceptance_criteria: Missing/malformed/stale review cannot approve.
Approval is bound to current attempt/head/diff evidence.

packets.title: Fail loud on invalid validation commands
packets.objective: Ensure declared validation commands that cannot start or target dead paths are recorded as failures rather than skipped or converted to success.
acceptance_criteria: Every declared command has exit/start evidence.
Any declared validation failure blocks success.

packets.title: Catch scope violations before review
packets.objective: Check changed paths against allowed_paths immediately after implementation so out-of-scope work fails before spending on review.
acceptance_criteria: Violation names exact offending paths and review is not invoked.
Allowed nested paths continue to pass.

packets.title: Bind approval to exact current code
packets.objective: Invalidate approval after any post-review mutation and require a fresh exact-head/diff review.
acceptance_criteria: Approval records exact head and diff hash.
Post-review mutation makes the prior approval unusable.

packets.title: Prove shadow mode cannot publish
packets.objective: Prove default run-packet shadow execution cannot push, create PRs, merge or mutate remote refs even after a successful review.
acceptance_criteria: No GitHub mutation is invoked in shadow mode.
Result clearly distinguishes completion from publication.

packets.title: Stop hiding queue JSON corruption
packets.objective: Treat malformed persisted acceptance criteria or event payload JSON as explicit durable corruption instead of silently returning None.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed JSON raises a precise corruption error with record/field identity.
Valid optional null fields remain supported.

packets.title: Stop hiding run JSON corruption
packets.objective: Treat malformed run command_json/final_report_json as explicit durable corruption rather than missing values.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed run JSON fails loud with run/field identity.
Valid unfinished null final_report remains supported.

packets.title: Classify attempt evidence corruption
packets.objective: Wrap malformed persisted attempt/result/validation/review JSON in a precise Builder corruption error instead of generic JSONDecodeError or partial data.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed evidence fails loud with attempt/field identity.
No partial attempt is returned after decode failure.

packets.title: Validate task contracts before enqueue
packets.objective: Reject malformed allowed paths, acceptance criteria, priority or bridge identifiers before inserting durable queue state.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid contract creates no partial task/event rows.
Valid legacy callers remain compatible.

packets.title: Validate run commands before persistence
packets.objective: Reject empty/malformed run commands or task/worker/lease identity mismatches before creating a misleading running record.
acceptance_criteria: Rejected start creates no running record.
Valid command preserves exact argv and owner identity.

packets.title: Prove initiative apply idempotency
packets.objective: Ensure identical manifest reapply creates one mapping/task while a conflicting same-id manifest fails without partial mutation.
acceptance_criteria: Identical apply is idempotent.
Conflict preserves the original initiative and creates no duplicate task.

packets.title: Keep dependency eligibility deterministic
packets.objective: Cover completed, failed, cancelled, paused and blocked prerequisites so dependents neither run early nor disappear behind ambiguous state.
acceptance_criteria: Only satisfied dependencies make a packet eligible.
Permanent versus temporary blockers remain distinct.

packets.title: Put execution identity in initiative reports
packets.objective: Expose actual route/provider/model and attempt outcomes in supported initiative report output without raw prompts or credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Report identifies free/paid and actual model when known.
Missing evidence is unknown rather than guessed.

packets.title: Fence attempts to their original lease
packets.objective: Prove a stale worker cannot close/release or mutate a successor attempt/lease.
acceptance_criteria: Stale lease cannot close successor work.
Correct bound lease closes exactly once without altering another worker.

packets.title: Audit operator attempt-budget grants
packets.objective: Record who/why/how many for every attempt-budget grant and expose it through supported evidence instead of only changing counters.
acceptance_criteria: Grant reason and amount are bounded and durable.
No grant occurs implicitly or without task/packet identity.

packets.title: Enforce max_attempts exactly
packets.objective: Cover max_attempts=1/2 and operator grants so Builder neither creates a hidden extra attempt nor refuses a valid remaining attempt.
acceptance_criteria: Budget exhaustion occurs before worker launch.
Grant extends only by recorded amount and infra/provider failures stay separately accounted.

packets.title: Prevent duplicate autonomous launches
packets.objective: Prove overlapping supervisor ticks cannot launch multiple detached run-packet processes for the same task around lock release/run-record lag.
acceptance_criteria: At most one live autonomous launch exists per task.
Finished work becomes eligible only according to durable task state.

packets.title: Keep packet base SHA immutable
packets.objective: Prove retries, recovery, supervisor ticks and moving origin/main never recompute an applied packet's creation-time base SHA.
acceptance_criteria: Applied packet keeps one full immutable base SHA.
Retry/recovery resets to stored base and report exposes it.
